property_summary: For any non-empty _tos and matching v lengths, c.transfer either returns true without reverting when all external calls succeed, or reverts; it must not return false.
For any non-empty _tos with equal v length, c.transfer either reverts or returns true (it never returns false).
If transfer is called with _tos.length > 0 and matching lengths, then it cannot both return true and also revert (i.e., if it returns, the return value must be true).
